strict.scope: Full physics step; synchronized wall time; excludes rendering, recording, diagnostics, and reset.
strict.warmup: One complete rollout before measurements; every repeat starts from the same recorded state.
strict.stage_scope: CUDA events in a separate rollout; includes possible launch gaps, not isolated kernel durations.
strict.contact_method: Relaxed Jacobi; same unilateral/Coulomb equations; unrelaxed impulse residual < 1e-9 N s.

iteration_accuracy.scope:
Compare contact iteration budgets on complete learned particle/body rollouts.

Every budget starts from the same recorded state. Errors compare each rollout
with the tightly converged estimator, not with MPM. Diagnostic readbacks are
intentional here; use profile_gpu.py separately for timing.

local_fit_limitations: Zero gradient beyond 0.065 m from the moving body is an optional approximation. Contact selection still checks every particle. Not tested under arbitrary mouse forces.
tests: 21 focused tests passed; affine gradient, no host copies, reduced mass, friction, moments, external wrench, and overflow.
